title: [Shopify] Show configured product status in Add to Shopify confirmation
summary: The Shopify connector now displays the configured product status (Active, Draft, or Unlisted) in the Add to Shopify confirmation dialog, with SetIsActive obsoleted in favor of SetProductStatus.
key_points: Passes full configured product status to Add to Shopify confirmation dialog
Shows correct confirmation text for Active, Draft, and Unlisted products
Obsoletes SetIsActive in favor of SetProductStatus
Adds regression test coverage for all three product statuses
quote: Show the correct confirmation text for Active, Draft, and Unlisted products.
